svg.title: GridGuard attack, detection, and alert data flow
svg.desc: Three deterministic scenarios feed the IEEE 13-node power simulator. Nine Modbus holding registers are decoded into grid telemetry. The ingestor applies a voltage envelope detector and forwards the explicit attack flag, then writes telemetry and detections to InfluxDB. Grafana presents sixteen panels and three alert rules. Baseline produces no sample-level detection, the naive attack triggers both detectors, and the coordinated in-envelope replay triggers only the ground-truth flag, exposing the threshold detector gap.
svg.text: The detector catches the obvious attack and documents what it misses
Raw measurements and security decisions stay separate, joined by bounded tags for scenario, source, feeder, signal, bus, and phase.
RECORDED OUTCOMES / SAME PIPELINE, DIFFERENT INPUT
Telemetry changes over time; dashboard queries pass.
0.88 pu crosses the lower voltage threshold.
Voltage stays inside 0.95-1.05 pu despite coordinated shifts.
Known gap: no topology/state-estimator detector yet.
Blue = telemetry · green = detector event · red = threshold violation · amber = explicit test ground truth
Source: detection.py + register map + Grafana provisioning · validated in CI
